coefficient_gauge: Evaluation only: one complex scalar minimizes coefficient squared error. Unaligned errors are also reported.
selection: Training-only common gain and nominal-centered ridge; the unchanged 25 alpha grid is selected by independent noisy spatial validation. Truth, injected labels and final test are excluded.
state_stability: Unknown nonreference per-element state errors are fixed over training, validation and test; reference unchanged. No inter-session gain, phase, base-response drift, geometry or probe uncertainty.
noise: Each plane uses uncoded initial clean RMS/100, fixed across the four codes. Proper complex independent state/plane noise; matched latent streams across regimes and healthy/faulted cases.
seed_policy: Normal/fault streams use root.spawn(3); receiver noise keys (64001,plane,state); state errors keys (64002,state).spawn(2). Pairing across regimes/health intentional. All replicate roots below are disjoint from historical/development roots.
domain_assignment: Preassigned by simulation state-error regime; no truth-based selection, rejection, relabeling or conditional relaxation.
rejection_rule: None. Failed, timed-out, unstarted and rejected cases remain in their registered denominator and fail baseline acceptance.
coefficient_acceptance: Every registered declared-domain case must return successfully and meet all three baseline gates. Fault detection is descriptive and separately scored.
limitations: Scalar equivalent radiating coefficients only; relative gain/phase accuracy.
11.7 GHz only; one specified i.i.d. normal scatter distribution.
Stable known geometry, ideal nominal coding, unknown fixed-per-code errors.
Finite Monte Carlo evidence is not a universal guarantee or 95 percent reliability certification.
No GPU, real-hardware, session-drift or injected-fault diagnosis certification.
question: Independent confirmation of the inherited stable mild K4 first-version domain; frozen before any new scientific result.
stopping_rule: Exactly 20 cases unless execution budget is exceeded. No retuning after reading results. Any unmet case means baseline not confirmed for this version; preserve complete denominator. No midpoint promotion from development.
